verses.english: “There are these two kinds of worship.
Worship of things of the flesh and worship of the teaching.
These are the two kinds of worship.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ dvinnaṁ pūjānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammapūjā”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of worship is worship of the teaching.”
